description: Combines foresight with public participation community voice adaptive design and transparent accountability.
Uses scenarios monitoring adaptive triggers and institutional learning to remain viable under changing conditions.
Invests in prevention early warning maintenance emergency capacity and public learning before crisis.
Prioritizes robustness equity public legitimacy and resilience under uncertain future conditions.
Coordinates industrial policy labor transition regional investment supply chains and long-term competitiveness.
Optimizes measurable efficiency while risking legitimacy equity and resilience gaps.
Responds to visible pressure but underinvests in prevention adaptation and long-term capacity.
Prioritizes short-term budget reduction while increasing deferred risk and future crisis exposure.
